before_any_output_of: same-dataset ceiling of the amend10 learned head (reports/head_upper.json, HEAD_RESULTS.md section 'same-dataset ceiling')
question: amend10 trained on LVOS v2 only (no eligible MOSEv2/VOST extras). Does a head trained on the SAME datasets reach switch precision 0.70? If not even here, the failure is not cross-dataset transfer.
data: outputs/milestone10/runpod/runs/OR0K (dev, 109 units, OR0-identical). No new GPU output. The dev split is used for training here, which is why the result can never be adopted.
folds: 5 folds by video, assigned within each dataset (MOSEv2, VOST, LVOS v2 separately, seed 0), so every held-out video has same-dataset training videos. Each row is scored by the model that did not see its video (OOF).
models_and_hyper: identical to amend10 (scripts/m10_head.py HYPER, SCALAR, models R_piou, a, b, c, null_b, null_c, H1 and H2, training rows = in-scope frames). Nothing retuned.
tau: tau* = smallest tau on the amend10 grid (0 + quantiles 0.05..0.95 of positive OOF margins) where the POOLED MOSEv2+VOST OOF precision >= 0.70 with >= 20 switches. tau is chosen on the same OOF scores it is evaluated on, so the result is an optimistic ceiling.
report: per model and hypothesis: max pooled MOSEv2+VOST precision over the grid (>= 20 switches) with switch count; at tau*: amend5 gate_eval per dataset (dJ on GT-present frames, video bootstrap CI) and the amend10 criteria (1)-(4) as a description, not a decision.
reading_rule: If no learned model reaches tau* here: 'even trained on the same datasets, the head does not reach 0.70' -> the amend10 failure is not explained by LVOS-only training. If one does: report it as a same-dataset ceiling only; it says the information exists but a transferable training set would be needed. Either way the next step is the wrap-up (da).
